verdicts.reason: Both use the same left text block: quote mark, headline, attribution. In both, the brand logo floats in the middle of the banner, cut off from the other elements. A shrinks the can to a tiny icon in the middle of a full circle, so the SOLSTICE label can't be read and the product is trivial. B keeps the can much larger with the circle bleeding off the edge like the original, so the product holds up better, though its label is still very small and the can sits close to the bottom edge.
